rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize test thresholds and parameters
Detect pressure sensor wire break or under-pressure fault
Detect over-pressure fault
Detect supply air low fault while cycle is active
Reset faults on pushbutton press
Evaluate master fault and drive fault beacon
Manual vent valve override in manual mode
Start automatic cycle and initialize results on pallet presence
Step CLAMP: Wait for clamp closed to advance to FILL
Step FILL: Fill timeout timer
Step FILL: Trigger timeout fault if fill takes too long
Step FILL: Advance to STABILISE when fill complete threshold is reached
Step STABILISE: Stabilization timer
Capture initial test pressure to D110
Step STABILISE: Advance to TEST step when timer done
Step TEST: Pressure decay test timer
Step TEST: Capture final pressure and calculate decay when timer done
Step TEST: Evaluate PASS/FAIL result based on calculated decay
Step TEST: Advance to VENT step when test timer done
Abort active cycle to VENT step on master fault
Step VENT: Vent timer
Step VENT: Advance to UNCLAMP when pressure drops and timer done
Step UNCLAMP: Wait for clamp open to advance to COMPLETE
Step COMPLETE: Wait for pallet removal to clear busy state
Output: Drive clamp close solenoid during active steps
Output: Drive fill valve during FILL step if no fault
Output: Drive vent valve during VENT step or on over-pressure fault
Output: Send ST20 PASS or FAIL signals to line controller
End of program
